channel.title: News Talk 980 CKNW - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from News Talk 980 CKNW (cknw.com)

item.title: Explosion outside U.S. Embassy in Oslo under investigation: police
item.description: PST, the Norwegian police security service, called in additional personnel following the incident but has not changed the country's terror threat level.

item.title: Hamilton police urge safety after 6 people fall through ice
item.description: Hamilton police are urging people not to go on frozen waterways as temperatures rise, saying it puts not only those on the ice in danger but also those who try to rescue them.

item.title: War in Iran: Canadians leaving Middle East by plane, bus and foot
item.description: Amid the war in Iran, Canadians continue to request help in leaving the Middle East. Global Affairs Canada says several flights, buses and pedestrian crossings have been arranged.

item.title: The Curator: Here’s how to deep clean your bedroom
item.description: A dusty room can ruin a good night’s sleep. If you’re tackling a bedroom deep clean, target these common dust hotspots and follow these simple tips to remove dust and allergens.

item.title: WATCH: Global News Hour at 6 BC: Mar. 8
item.description: Watch the online edition of Global News Hour at 6 BC.

item.title: OPP say they rescued 23 people after ice shelf broke from Georgian Bay shore
item.description: Members from the Grey-Bruce detachment of the Ontario Provincial Police say they received a report of numerous people becoming stranded Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Much of Alberta, parts of B.C. and Saskatchewan set to see dangerous winds
item.description: The weather agency says high-sided vehicles could be pushed around by the wind, and there could be damage to roofs, fences, tress and soft shelters.

item.title: B.C.’s Natalie Wilkie takes home Canada’s 1st gold at Winter Paralympics
item.description: It's Natalie Wilkie's fourth career Paralympic gold medal for the Canadian flag-bearer and her ninth Paralympic medal overall. She also won a silver on Saturday.

item.title: Barrett’s season-high 31 leads Raptors past Mavs
item.description: RJ Barrett of Mississauga, Ont., had a season-high 31 points to lead the Toronto Raptors in a 122-92 rout of the Dallas Mavericks on Sunday.

item.title: Most Canadians want former prince Andrew removed from line to throne: poll
item.description: A survey found a majority of Canadians want Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor to lose his claim to the throne, while 51 per cent say the Royal Family is not relevant to them personally.
